purpose: Own the host-issued manager uniqueness scope, controller identity and generation, bounded live-session capacity, scope-bound handle issuance, and the single ordered validation path (handle, context, time, action) that precedes every mutation, resolving every time decision through the authority and exposing a zero normal-route emission counter.
interfaces: register_controller(ControllerId id, ControllerName name) -> Result (Ok | InvalidController | CapacityExhausted); issues Generation 1 under the manager's non-zero uniqueness scope
consume(ControllerId, const Permit&, const SessionContext&, SessionHandle& out) -> Result

transition(SessionHandle, LifecycleAction, ClockDomainId now_domain, Timestamp now_value, Diagnostic& out) -> Result (now_domain/now_value is a caller claim cross-checked against the authority's reading)
capacity() const -> std::size_t; emission_count() const -> std::uint64_t (always zero)
inputs: ManagerScope (host-supplied, non-zero, fresh per instance and recreation); ControllerId (host-issued); ControllerName; Permit; SessionContext; SessionHandle; LifecycleAction; ClockDomainId now_domain (claim domain); Timestamp now_value (claim value).
outputs: ControllerId, SessionHandle, Result, LifecycleState, Diagnostic, and the zero emission counter.
state: Host-supplied non-zero ManagerScope required at construction and bound into every issued handle.
Controller table (controller id -> generation, name) with a bounded superseded-controller window.
Live session table bounded by max_sessions, each entry binding a session, its permit identity, and owning controller id/generation.
A single std::mutex guarding all manager state; non-copyable and non-movable.
errors: InvalidHandle, ForeignHandle, StaleHandle, RecreatedController, SessionNotFound, InvalidController (zero or already-registered controller identity at registration).
UnknownClock, MissingMapping, ToleranceExceeded, ClockRegression, ClockOverflow, ClockSourceFailure, ClockOutOfBounds, PermitNotYetValid, PermitExpired.
UndefinedAction, ActionNotAllowed, InvalidTransition, TerminalState, QuotaExhausted, AlreadyApplied.
invariants: Validation of handle, context, time, and action completes before any state mutation.

Every handle binds the manager's non-zero uniqueness scope, the controller identity, generation, and session identity; the scope is validated first, so a handle from a different or recreated manager is ForeignHandle before any session is addressed.

now_domain/now_value is a caller claim, never trusted directly: the manager obtains the authority's reading in the claim domain, cross-checks the claim (full-range distance must be zero), maps to the validity domain when needed, and only then tests [valid_from, valid_until).
A failed consume returns no usable handle and leaves capacity and consumed sets unchanged.
Terminal/closed reclamation frees exactly one capacity slot for reuse.
emission_count() is always 0 and the class exposes no emission, transport, journal, or persistence API.
concurrency: All operations take the single std::mutex; concurrent consumes and transitions serialize deterministically, and exactly-once consumption holds under concurrency via the registry's atomic check-then-insert.
